mentions.name: Pithos
mentions.description: Pithos is a zero-dependency TypeScript utility ecosystem that ships five modules in one package: data utilities (Arkhe), schema validation (Kanon), Result/Option types (Zygos), typed error classes (Sphalma), and a Lodash migration bridge (Taphos). The patterns compose natively—validate with Kanon, receive a typed Result via Zygos, and chain transformations with Arkhe—in one pipeline with no try/catch and full type inference. Benchmarks claim ~4x smaller and 5-11x faster than Zod 4, ~21x smaller than Lodash, and ~3x smaller than Neverthrow. Available on npm as @pithos/core.
